utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice — what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re reading a mystery novel this week. I can bring the discussion notes if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks — I’d love to take a look before we meet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Book club, right? Give me the quick version and I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Quick version: we pick one book, meet once a month, and keep it low-key. If that works, I’ll send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send the details and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we really meeting for book club this week, Pia?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to double-check the time and place first so nobody shows up to the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the time and place for me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the book club! I’m sorry, did we decide on a book already, or are we still picking one?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still picking one, I think — I can check the list and see what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. I keep mixing up the options, so I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the book club details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I say anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that — what details did we settle on again?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — let’s confirm the date, time, and the book title first, then I’ll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — what book did the club settle on?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we picked "The Midnight Library" for this month. Should be a good one!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh nice, I’ve been wanting to read that one. What day are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your folding chairs and maybe help set out the sign-in sheet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can bring the folding chairs and set out the sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where’s the book club meeting this time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check the school calendar, but I think it’s in the library after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps—I’ll check the library after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking a new novel this week, and I’m curious what everyone lands on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh nice — you should come with us this week! I’ll text you the details as soon as I hear the pick.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Rosa, thanks — I’m usually available on Tuesdays and Thursdays. If those work, you can put me in for either one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you decided which book the club is reading next?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I’m still thinking it over. What are the options?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can send you the shortlist if you want, or we can pick from the last few nominees.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what everyone wants to read and then I’ll bring it up at book club.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for your update and see what the group picks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll ask around and let you know what everyone wants to read.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m glad we’re getting the book club rolling. What day works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thursday works best for me. I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you. I’ll send you everyone’s starting spots and pickup times now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking a really good one this month—want me to see what everyone’s reading?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please do. I’d appreciate a clear list, then I can decide.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and bring you a clear list of what everyone’s reading. Then you can pick whichever sounds best.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what book club pick are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we’re talking about the new mystery pick. I’ll remind everyone we’re meeting Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh nice, thanks — I’m in for Thursday at 7. What’s the title of the mystery pick?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I’d be happy to hear what you’re reading.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. We’re reading a novel I’m still getting into, but it’s been a nice distraction.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice—sometimes a good distraction is exactly what you need. What’s the novel about?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the book club reading next?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can skim it—what’s the title?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to help bring everyone together for book club—what are you all reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the list first so I don’t mix anything up—what title did we pick for this week?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries—just send me the title when you’ve got it, and I’ll help keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Mara — book club, right? I might’ve missed the details, but I’m in if you want to fill me in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — we’re meeting Thursday evening at my place, and this month we’re reading "The Glass Hotel." I can send you the address and time again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting this week—are we still doing it at the library?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate that. Just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Ira — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus. I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Leo — I’d be glad to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help pick the next book and let me know if you can bring a few extra chairs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can help pick the next book, and I can bring a few extra chairs too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can come, but I’d like to know the time and where we’re meeting first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 4:30 should work for me, as long as we wrap up before pickup chaos starts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good to me — what place are we meeting at? I just want to make sure I can get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, please — I’d appreciate the address and time again. Thursday evening at your place works for me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — it’s Thursday at 7 at my place, 214 Maple Lane. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Cleo — I’ve got it down. See you Thursday at 7 at 214 Maple Lane!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I’d love that—our book club is meeting this Thursday evening, and you’re very welcome to join us!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that sounds lovely—what time on Thursday should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re starting at 7:00 p.m. over at my place—come a little early if you’d like a cup of tea first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh—right, the carpool. I think we’re leaving around 8, and it should just be me and Ben riding with you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, perfect — thanks for the update. I’ll plan on being ready around 8.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll text if anything changes. See you around 8!
